name: say
description: Hook-enforced ASD-STE100 controlled replies for coding agents. Rules inject at session start, re-anchor every turn, and a Stop-hook gate audits every finished reply against the active tier (60 lite / 80 default / 100 strict). Native Claude Code / ZCode plugin; installs into 19 more harnesses (Codex, Gemini, Qwen, iFlow, OpenCode, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Roo, Kilo, Goose, Crush, Amp, Droid, Kimi, Copilot, Trae, Hermes, pi) via scripts/install.js.
